ev.q: Gameplay consists of the player building bases on a distant planet
fantastic blend of real-time strategy and bullet hell combat
The player must explore the planet Galatea 37 to find resources
The research is guided by a tech tree where the player can specify what to research next
Different research tracks unlock newer and better weapons
provides an intense challenge and an addictive RPG loop
Cooperative multiplayer featuring Campaign Coop & Survival mode
